name: @holoscript/cli
description: Command-line interface for HoloScript — run, compile, validate, serve, and analyze .hs, .hsplus, and .holo programs

scripts.test:public-receipts: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck test/public-receipt-api.consumer.ts && node -e "const api=require('./dist/index.js'); for (const key of ['HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SCHEMA','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V3','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V4','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY_V3','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY_V4','HEADLESS_OBSERVER_PROJECTION_SCHEMA','HEADLESS_OBSERVER_PROOF_SCHEMA','SINGLE_EXECUTION_POST_SEAL_OBSERVER','POST_SEAL_OBSERVER_PROCESS','HOLO_WORLD_PROJECTION_COVERAGE','HOLO_WORLD_PROJECTION_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA','DETERMINISTIC_HOLO_WORLD_PROJECTION','executeHoloWorldProjection','observeHeadlessExperimentReceipt','runHeadlessExperimentSources','verifyHoloWorldProjectionProvenance','verifyHeadlessExperimentSourceRunReceipt','HOLO_CPU_PHYSICS_RECEIPT_SCHEMA','HOLO_CPU_PHYSICS_ENGINE','HOLO_CPU_PHYSICS_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA','HOLOLAND_PHYSICS_OBSERVER_SCHEMA','executeHoloCpuPhysicsReceipt','verifyHoloCpuPhysicsReceipt','HS_PLAN_KERNEL_EXECUTION_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA','verifyHsPlanKernelExecutionProvenance']) if (api[key] === undefined) throw new Error('missing public receipt API: ' + key); for (const key of ['HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SCHEMA','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V3','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V4','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY_V3','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY_V4','HEADLESS_OBSERVER_PROJECTION_SCHEMA','HEADLESS_OBSERVER_PROOF_SCHEMA','SINGLE_EXECUTION_POST_SEAL_OBSERVER','POST_SEAL_OBSERVER_PROCESS']) { const value=api[key]; if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Object.isFrozen(value)) throw new Error('mutable public headless receipt constant: ' + key); } for (const key of ['HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY_V3','HEADLESS_SOURCE_RUN_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY_V4','HOLO_CPU_PHYSICS_LIMITS','HS_PLAN_KERNEL_TRACE_PROGRAM_COUNTERS','HS_PLAN_KERNEL_TRACE_OPCODES']) if (!Object.isFrozen(api[key])) throw new Error('mutable public receipt constant: ' + key);"
